title: Draganfly Signs Two Agreements at Canadian Embassy in Kyiv to Advance Canada–Ukraine Unmanned Systems Collaboration
body_markdown:
*Agreements with TAF Industries and DOD Solution advance cooperation in manufacturing and onboard autonomy*


**KYIV, Ukraine, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —** Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO; CSE: DPRO; FSE: 3U8) (“Draganfly” or the “Company”), a Canadian-headquartered developer of advanced drone solutions, unmanned systems and software, today announced the signing of two memoranda of understanding (MOUs) with TAF Industries and DOD Solution during a ceremony held at the Embassy of Canada to Ukraine in Kyiv on November 20, 2026.


The MOUs advance cooperation in unmanned systems manufacturing and onboard autonomy. They bring together Ukrainian technology and operational experience with Draganfly’s Canadian engineering, manufacturing and systems-integration capabilities to support evolving requirements in Canada, Ukraine and allied markets.


The agreements are consistent with the objectives of the Canada–Ukraine Declaration for a 100-Year Partnership, signed by Prime Minister Mark Carney and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Calgary on September 10, 2026. The declaration set out a long-term vision for deeper cooperation across security, trade, technology and economic development. Its defence-industrial priorities include joint production of unmanned systems, research and development, testing and evaluation, technology transfer and licensing, combining Ukraine’s operational innovation with Canada’s industrial and technological strengths.


“The Embassy of Canada to Ukraine welcomes these and other examples of increasing collaboration between Canadian and Ukrainian defence technology companies.” Peter Cahill, Senior Trade Commissioner, Embassy of Canada to Ukraine.


Draganfly’s collaborations reflect that shared direction through proposed Canadian manufacturing and autonomy integration.


The DOD Solution MOU builds on Draganfly’s previously announced strategic investment in the company and establishes a framework for longer-term cooperation in autonomy development and systems integration.


“Draganfly is committed to supporting Ukraine through practical, long-term relationships with its technology developers,” said Cameron Chell, Chief Executive Officer of Draganfly. “These agreements connect the technology with the ability to manufacture and support it. Our focus is on combining Ukrainian innovation and operational experience with our capabilities in Canada to support Ukrainian, Canadian and allied requirements.”


**TAF Industries: Manufacturing and Industrial Cooperation**


Draganfly’s memorandum of understanding with TAF Industries, a Ukrainian defence technology manufacturer, establishes a framework to explore the development, manufacture and integration of Ukrainian unmanned systems technologies in Canada. The companies intend to evaluate selected unmanned aerial systems and unmanned ground vehicles for Canadian manufacturing, explore joint research and development, and assess regulatory, supply-chain and production requirements. The collaboration is intended to guide potential longer-term industrial cooperation and the development of capabilities responsive to Canadian and Ukrainian needs.


**DOD Solution: Autonomy Integration and Development**


The memorandum of understanding with DOD Solution, an Estonian-Ukrainian developer of onboard autonomy technology, advances collaboration on integrating its technology into selected Draganfly unmanned systems. The collaboration combines DOD Solution autonomy expertise and insights from Ukraine with Draganfly’s Canadian engineering and systems-integration capabilities. The work includes exploring how DOD Solution AURA AI platform can be adapted and evaluated for applications where GPS or communications may be degraded or unavailable.


The collaborations create opportunities to apply lessons from Ukraine to the development and evaluation of unmanned systems, strengthen Canadian technical expertise and give Ukrainian partners avenues to share their expertise and explore additional markets.


The scope, timing and implementation of activities under each agreement are subject to its respective terms, ongoing technical evaluation, and applicable regulatory approvals.


**About Draganfly**


Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO; CSE: DPRO; FSE: 3U8) is a Canadian-headquartered developer of advanced drone solutions, unmanned systems and software serving customers across North America and globally. With more than 27 years of experience in unmanned systems, Draganfly develops and delivers technologies spanning aerial platforms, autonomy, sensing, payload integration and mission-specific solutions for defence, public safety and commercial applications.


The Company combines engineering, manufacturing, software and systems-integration capabilities to support customers operating in complex and mission-critical environments. Draganfly is driven by a mission to provide innovative, reliable solutions that save time, money and lives.
